summary.title: Digital Product Passport — Terminology
summary.description:
Digital Product Passport terminology harvested from the
EN 18216–18246:2026 terms-and-definitions clauses, CWA 18291:2025
and IDTA 01001-3.2, plus framework terms proposed by UniDPP and
marked as such. Working dataset; the single source of truth for
the proposed ISO 25534-1 Part 1 (Vocabulary) draft.

ref: UniDPP working dataset — Digital Product Passport Terminology
